purpose: Resolve the single one-dimensional WP3-MULTI-CAND-v2 spectral subspace without opening the publication reserve and without promoting a backend-uncertain singular direction to an invariant claim.
prelock_disclosure: Before this specification was locked, only campaign status and expression-free spectral metadata were read: one dimension-one cluster at mode rank one, generalized singular value 7.081552551265169e-13, backend uncertainty 8.832165358133346e-13, guarded lower bound zero, and candidate threshold 1e-10. No coefficient, top-term, or candidate-expression field was inspected.
evidence_boundary: A REJECTED result establishes only that the v2 spectral subspace failed this frozen backend, diagnostic, or independent challenge protocol; it does not convert the original search into a backend-guarded bounded-null certificate and does not prove absence of integrals. An EXACT_KNOWN_DIRECTION result requires a newly locked search with the enlarged exact module. A SURVIVES result authorizes only a new candidate-specific qualification specification; it does not authorize reserve access, invariant interpretation as a theorem, WP4 work, or a publication claim. The 24-case publication reserve remains sealed throughout this campaign.

challenge_corpus.generator: deterministic exact-rational barycentric three-body states converted once to binary64

resolution_protocol.committed_candidate_integrity: Extract exactly the rank-one coefficient vector from the prerequisite result only after this specification lock verifies.
resolution_protocol.existing_diagnostics: Require the committed basis direction to pass its frozen training, calibration, family-fold, trajectory-drift, and gauge diagnostics.
backend_replication: Rebuild the frozen development and calibration matrices byte-identically.
Recompute the generalized subspace with NumPy SVD and SciPy LAPACK gesdd and gesvd drivers.
Compare rank-one coefficient subspaces after the same exact-zero and angular-momentum-squared quotient.
resolution_protocol.independent_evaluation: Evaluate the committed and replicated directions on the frozen challenge corpus with both production binary64 code and a source-disjoint mpmath implementation at 80 decimal digits.
resolution_protocol.formula_resolution: After the implementation lock, inspect top terms and attempt bounded rational reconstruction relative to the dominant coefficient. Test any reconstructed expression on every frozen and challenge point.
resolution_protocol.known_direction_test: Test coefficient projection against angular momentum squared, exact Reynolds identities, constants on the fixed-energy surface, and any exact formula identified by rational reconstruction.
resolution_protocol.reserve: Do not read, materialize, or execute any sealed publication-reserve source row.

decision_policy.REJECTED_NUMERICAL_OR_GENERALIZATION_ART: Any required existing diagnostic, backend stability, independent challenge, or precision agreement gate fails. No candidate claim is authorized; the original search remains spectrally unresolved rather than becoming a bounded null.
decision_policy.EXACT_KNOWN_DIRECTION: All numeric gates pass and the direction is identified as an exact known or identity direction. A successor search specification with an enlarged exact module is required before any null claim.
decision_policy.SURVIVES_RESOLUTION: All numeric gates pass and the direction is nontrivial and reproducible. Freeze a new candidate-specific qualification specification before any reserve access or substantive invariant claim.
decision_policy.SURVIVES_NUMERICALLY_FORMULA_UNRESOLVED: All numeric gates pass but no exact expression meets the reconstruction gate. Further unsealed resolution is required; reserve access and interpretation remain prohibited.
decision_policy.INVALID: Any prerequisite, lock, corpus, candidate-count, dimension, implementation, or reserve-integrity check fails.
